phases.objective: Restore exact-head read-only generated-artifact validation without evaluating runner context before allocation.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions planner and pull-request validator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository governed pull request or exact manual validation dispatch
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow registers, initializes bounded report paths after runner allocation, validates the exact head read-only, and uploads canonical no-secret evidence.
steps: Plan the event without job-level runner context.
Allocate the runner and publish bounded report paths through GITHUB_ENV.
Checkout and verify the exact remote branch head with credentials disabled.
Evaluate generated artifacts without repository mutation.
Upload and enforce the canonical structured report.
assertions: No runner.temp expression exists in job-level workflow context.
The workflow has read-only contents permission and no write permissions, git push, recovery activation, or recovery dispatch.
Report files are created below RUNNER_TEMP only after runner allocation.
The registration and authority boundary is documented.
No Production, provider, credential, SQL, migration, database, protected-ref, force-push, or external-send authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Preserve exact-head identity, bounded evidence, read-only authority, and independent governed mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Static workflow, documented boundary, and executable regression validation
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow remains a read-only verifier while all repository-writing authority stays outside pull-request validation.
steps: Validate exact-head checkout and remote readback.
assertions: Pull-request validation cannot mutate repository or Actions state.

phases.objective: Fail closed if unavailable runner context or pull-request write authority returns.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Any future change to the repaired workflow, documentation, or regression contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Regression rejects pre-allocation runner context, write permissions, recovery activation, mutation commands, or missing bounded report initialization.
steps: Reject write authority and recovery mutation paths.
assertions: No secrets are included in evidence.

phases.objective: This workflow-registration repair has no provider canary authority.
This repair performs no Production action or deployment.
